title: SoK: Systematizing LLM Prompt Security: Taxonomies, Datasets, and Unified Evaluation of Attacks and Defenses
abstract: arXiv:2510.15476v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prompt-security claims for large language models (LLMs) are often compared as properties of individual attacks or defenses, although measured harmfulness depends on the target model, access setting, attack and defense configuration, prompt sample, and judger. We systematize 272 studies through three linked, multi-label taxonomies of jailbreak attacks, defenses, and model vulnerabilities. To make these dependencies explicit, we introduce an access-compatible evaluation protocol over configured $\langle M,A,D,S,J\rangle$ tuples and instantiate it in PromptSecurity, an open-source platform that records method settings, outputs, judgments, and query costs. We release two complementary datasets: JailbreakDB, with 445,752 jailbreak system-user prompt pairs and 1,094,122 benign prompts, and PromptSecurity-Eval, with 166,200 harmful-query and 9,200 benign-utility output records. translated_title: SoK：大语言模型提示安全的系统化研究：分类法、数据集与攻防的统一评估
translated_abstract: 针对大语言模型（LLM）的提示安全主张通常被当作单个攻击或防御的固有属性来进行比较，然而实际测得的危害性取决于目标模型、访问设置、攻击与防御配置、提示样本以及评判者。我们通过三个相互关联的多标签分类法（涵盖越狱攻击、防御措施和模型漏洞）对272项研究进行了系统化梳理。为了使这些依赖关系显式化，我们引入了一个兼容不同访问方式的评估协议，该协议基于配置好的⟨M,A,D,S,J⟩元组（模型、攻击、防御、样本、评判者），并在开源平台PromptSecurity中加以实现，该平台记录方法设置、输出结果、评判结论和查询成本。我们发布了两个互补的数据集：JailbreakDB，包含445,752对越狱系统-用户提示对和1,094,122条良性提示；PromptSecurity-Eval，包含166,200条有害查询输出记录和9,200条良性效用输出记录。我们评估了11个目标模型、20种攻击和9种防御方法。
tldr: 该论文通过三个关联的多标签分类法系统化了272项LLM提示安全研究，提出了基于⟨M,A,D,S,J⟩元组的统一评估协议及开源平台PromptSecurity，并发布了两个大规模数据集（JailbreakDB与PromptSecurity-Eval），实现了对越狱攻防可复现、可控变量的统一评估。
en_tdlr: This paper systematizes 272 LLM prompt-security studies through linked taxonomies and a unified evaluation protocol over configured ⟨M,A,D,S,J⟩ tuples, instantiating it in the open-source PromptSecurity platform and releasing two large-scale datasets (JailbreakDB and PromptSecurity-Eval) for reproducible, controlled evaluation of jailbreak attacks and defenses.
